intent: Actual DeepSeek-generated hypotheses and numerical baselines, with local inverse optimization and training-only feedback

candidates.NL4Opt: first12 official test records in published file order

admission: Deterministic parsers; original feasibility and optimum checked before masking. No replacement. NL4Opt uses official symbolic annotations and LP semantics. OptMATH directed tours exhaustively enumerated against published answers. MAMO integer diet matches public answer.
primary: K10, noiseCap0.1; source-equal averages over both seeds, each collection separately; all failures retained
augmentation: One original objective coefficient hidden; one synthetic nonnegative hinge penalty added. Soft penalty is an experimental augmentation, not an original benchmark annotation or real human preference. Known original costs normalized by known-only median. Feasible sets stay original.
logs: DeepSeek paraphrases qualitative operational facts without hidden weights. A separate stateless inference call sees the generated logs, known model and monitor definitions; never the oracle weights or test outcomes. Logs remain synthetic. No rejection by downstream performance.
hypotheses: LLM emits typed linear/excess expressions with variable/monitor names, thresholds, sign and theta placeholders; not executable Python. All-bank comparison enumerates declared monitors at the design threshold; it is an oracle-threshold diagnostic, not an unrestricted matrix method.
ablation: Actual API calls for correct logs, no logs and cyclically mismatched logs within collection. Pairing order fixed before outcomes. Same generated log and proposal reused across historical seeds; these are not independent LLM samples.
noise: Minimize fixed random positive auxiliary objective under true augmented objective <= optimum + cap*max(1,abs(optimum)); a bounded-gap synthetic choice distribution, not percent corrupted humans.
fit: Certified forward separation minimizes normalized suboptimality plus L1. ds_anchor uses epsilon-insensitive bounded-rationality loss (epsilon=declared cap) plus L1 distance to DS numerical prior. This is not Wasserstein DRO.
subgradient: 50 projected cyclic updates on DS features, step20/sqrt(t)/max(1,norm(g)); best training-loss iterate from initial and every10steps
feedback: One LLM revision from current hypotheses and top3 TRAINING suboptimality residual witnesses; no oracle costs, hidden truths, test data or test-based acceptance. Refit once and retain outcome whether better or worse.
uncertainty: 5000 source-paired bootstrap resamples, seed20261020, exploratory unadjusted. Missing cohort means remain null. Report each source min/median/max and exact numerator.
diagnostics: Structure F1 before/after pruning, true-term price relative MAE, full feature false-positive mass, decision regret and true/predicted costs. Pairwise ties only among observed held-out baseline plans; not a global worst-face certificate.

pricing.reportedCost: token-derived range, not account invoice; unreported failed-call usage unknown

preservation: Separate new output batch. Never overwrite the public stress test or current report. Archive final deliverables under 实验/.
